text:
clara: Quick postmortem follow-up. I made a compact action queue for the authz incident: https://tiny.redwood/pm-action-queue. Please claim items and note blockers.

noah: I can take token validation schema + telemetry (row 1). ETA 5 business days. Will add example failed-token payloads and alert thresholds.

eli: I will own secrets rotation automation (row 2). Plan: KMS key version rollout + CI token purge job. ETA 12 days. Will create PM ticket.

security-bot: Created tickets: PM-6105 (token-schema-telemetry), PM-6106 (secrets-rotation), PM-6107 (runbook-escalation). Links posted to tracker.

clara: Two cross-cutting asks: (1) mark any legacy CI/service accounts as "legacy_migration" in the sheet so we sequence safely, (2) add GDPR/CCPA compliance tags and retention justification to PMs before closing.

noah: Added sample query to PM-6105: `index=auth_logs event=token_validation result=fail | stats count by service` and provisional spike rule at 0.5% over 5m. Also proposing a weekly digest of services issuing tokens without ttl metadata.

eli: Uploaded a KMS map to PM-6106. Security recommends rotating the discovered key within 7 days unless it blocks production. Will include zero-downtime dual-acceptance window in the runbook.

compliance: Reminder: include data-classification and retention rationale in the PM ticket comments. Will review once tags present.

clara: Also noticed a repeated pattern across postmortems: missing TTL checks and long-lived ephemeral tokens. Proposing an automated quarterly audit + a CI merge-blocking linter for configs that create tokens without ttl or with ttl > 30d.

noah: I can add the linter rule for config files. Snippet I'll add to PM-6105: `if not config.get("token_ttl") or config["token_ttl"] > 2592000: fail`

eli: For rotation tickets, should we treat third-party integration tokens separately? Those often require vendor coordination.

clara: Yes, mark third-party tokens as "3rd_party:review" and create follow-ups if rotation is required. I'll add a column in the tracker.

ops-bot: Weekly checkpoint created for PM-6105 & PM-6106 every Wed 09:00 PT. Invites sent to owners.

noah: I'll wire alerting into staging and post tests in PM-6105 before the checkpoint.

eli: PR branch started: git.redwood/pr/1688 (kms-rotation/auto). Will attach test plan and rollback steps in PM-6106.

security-bot: Link note: PM-6106 is linked to vulnerability-board for rotation windows.

clara: If any change causes customer-facing auth failures, label the PM `blocking` and ping #eng-oncall per the runbook. Make sure runbook has the escalation flow.

noah: Will update runbook section with triage steps and automated escalation on surge of failed auths.

eli: Found 3 legacy CI accounts that store tokens long-term; marked them in the sheet as legacy_migration and flagged PM-6106 blocking for infra work.

compliance: Thanks, added provisional review date for PMs after owners add tags.

clara: Scheduling a 30m sync Fri 11:00 PT to review blockers and finalize ETAs. Owners, update tracker and paste PR/ticket links into the comments before the meeting. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
